changelog:
v2.0.10 (2026-04-24)

  • Fix: 404 Monitor reader now auto-detects the hit-count column (`times_accessed` on Rank Math 1.0.x+, `hits` on older installs). Previously queried a non-existent `hits` column on modern installs, returning zeroes.
  • Fix: Added `web-stories` and `llms-txt` to the known-module whitelist so enable/disable accepts them.
  • Critical fix (v2.0.9): Rank Math redirections `sources` column is now written PHP-serialized (maybe_serialize) instead of JSON. JSON silently crashed class-table.php:189 and broke the redirect module. Read path is tolerant of both formats.
  • New (v2.0.9): Rank Math modules management API — GET/POST /rankmath/modules, POST /rankmath/modules/enable, POST /rankmath/modules/disable.
  • New (v2.0.9): Rank Math 404 Monitor reader — GET /rankmath/404-monitor, /stats, DELETE /{id}, POST /clear.
  • Enhanced (v2.0.9): /health now reports rankmath_version, active modules, and presence of redirections + 404_logs tables.

v2.0.7 (2026-03-31)

  • Fix: Added defined() guards on SPILT_MCP_VERSION and SPILT_MCP_PATH constants — prevents fatal error when WP_Upgrader re-activates the plugin in the same PHP process during self-update.

v2.0.6 (2026-03-31)

  • Hotfix: Rebuilt release ZIP with forward-slash paths (Python zipfile). v2.0.5 ZIP used backslash separators from PowerShell Compress-Archive, breaking extraction on Linux hosts.

v2.0.5 (2026-03-31)

  • New: POST /cache/litespeed/preset and POST /cache/litespeed/purge endpoints.
